patch_description:
The current program uses 13 fixed CZ gates with no trainable parameters in the entangling block, limiting expressivity. Program 2 achieved the best score (0.66) by replacing Ising gates with CRZ gates, which are parametrized controlled-rotation gates offering better control over two-qubit interactions.

This edit replaces the fixed CZ entangling structure with parametrized CRZ gates using aggressive parameter sharing. We group the CRZ gates into two entangling blocks with shared parameters (ent_crzA, ent_crzB), which:
1. Adds trainability to two-qubit interactions
2. Reduces distinct parameters (from 9 to ~7)
3. Improves worst_group_margin by giving the optimizer more control
4. Speeds up convergence (critical for small training sets)

The pattern maintains the nearest-neighbor and mid-range connectivity that was successful in Program 2.
